body:
BILL Holdings, which makes accounts payable and spend management software for small and mid-sized businesses, agreed on Thursday, Nov. 19, to be taken private by TPG in partnership with Corpay for $63.25 a share in cash [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html). The deal values BILL at a fully diluted equity value of about $6.0 billion [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html).

The price is a 31% premium to BILL's 60-day volume-weighted average price ending on Nov. 16, "the last full trading day preceding media reports that BILL was in acquisition discussions," the company said [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html).

TPG will hold a majority interest through its TPG Capital buyout fund [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html). Corpay, the corporate payments company, will invest $1.1 billion for an approximately one-third equity stake, with an option to acquire 100% of BILL [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/corpay-invests-alongside-tpg-acquire-225100195.html). "We have the option to buy the rest of the company in 2030," Corpay Chief Financial Officer Peter Walker said, adding that Corpay expects the deal to add to its cash earnings per share in 2027 [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/corpay-invests-alongside-tpg-acquire-225100195.html). TPG and Corpay used the same structure to take AvidXchange private for $2.2 billion in 2025 [[3]](https://seekingalpha.com/pr/20093158-avidxchange-agrees-to-be-acquired-by-tpg-in-partnership-with-corpay-for-2_2-billion).

BILL's board approved the deal unanimously, it carries no financing condition, and it needs stockholder and regulatory approvals [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html). Starboard Value, BILL's largest stockholder, and founder and Chief Executive René Lacerte have agreed to vote their shares in favor [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html). Lacerte will remain CEO, and BILL's stock will be delisted after closing, which is expected in the first half of 2027 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html).

Goldman Sachs and Qatalyst Partners advised BILL; BofA Securities, Deutsche Bank Securities and RBC Capital Markets advised TPG; Barclays advised Corpay [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html).

It was the second sizable software deal of the day, after Intuit agreed to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion (our report).

p: 중소·중견기업을 위한 매입채무 및 지출 관리 소프트웨어를 개발하는 BILL Holdings는 11월 19일 목요일 TPG가 Corpay와 파트너십을 맺고 주당 63.25달러의 현금으로 인수하여 상장 폐지하기로 합의했다 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html). 이번 거래로 BILL의 완전희석 주식 가치는 약 60억 달러로 평가되었다 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html).

이번 인수가격은 "BILL이 인수 협상 중이라는 언론 보도가 나오기 전의 마지막 온전한 거래일"인 11월 16일 기준 BILL의 60일 거래량 가중 평균 주가 대비 31% 프리미엄이 붙은 수준이라고 회사는 밝혔다 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html).

TPG는 바이아웃 펀드인 TPG Capital을 통해 경영권 지분을 보유할 예정이다 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html). 기업 지급결제 회사인 Corpay는 약 3분의 1 지분 확보를 위해 11억 달러를 투자하며, BILL의 지분 100%를 인수할 수 있는 옵션을 갖는다 [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/corpay-invests-alongside-tpg-acquire-225100195.html). Corpay의 최고재무책임자(CFO)인 Peter Walker는 "우리는 2030년에 나머지 지분을 매입할 수 있는 옵션을 가지고 있다"며, Corpay가 이번 거래를 통해 2027년 현금 주당순이익(EPS)이 증가할 것으로 기대한다고 덧붙였다 [[2]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/corpay-invests-alongside-tpg-acquire-225100195.html). TPG와 Corpay는 2025년에도 동일한 구조를 활용해 22억 달러 규모로 AvidXchange를 비상장화한 바 있다 [[3]](https://seekingalpha.com/pr/20093158-avidxchange-agrees-to-be-acquired-by-tpg-in-partnership-with-corpay-for-2_2-billion).

BILL 이사회는 이번 거래를 만장일치로 승인했으며, 별도의 자금 조달 조건(financing condition)은 없고 주주 및 규제 기관의 승인이 필요하다 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html). BILL의 최대주주인 Starboard Value와 창업자이자 최고경영자(CEO)인 René Lacerte는 보유 지분을 찬성표로 행사하기로 합의했다 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html). Lacerte는 계속해서 CEO직을 유지할 예정이며, BILL의 주식은 2027년 상반기로 예상되는 거래 종결 후 상장 폐지된다 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html).

Goldman Sachs와 Qatalyst Partners가 BILL을 자문했고, BofA Securities, Deutsche Bank Securities, RBC Capital Markets가 TPG를 자문했으며, Barclays가 Corpay를 자문했다 [[1]](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/bill-agrees-acquired-tpg-partnership-224600587.html).
이는 Intuit가 Mailchimp를 Bending Spoons에 36억 8000만 달러에 매각하기로 합의한 데 이어, 이날 나온 두 번째 대형 소프트웨어 거래였다.
실시간 음성 복제 및 스타터 플랜 상업용 라이선스: 첫 달 1달러, 이후 월 6달러.
